name: Coconut milk
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Packaged coconut milk, fresh coconut milk, and coconut cream may be suitable depending on the recipe. Coconut cream is richer and is not always a direct replacement.

name: Cassava
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Peeled or frozen cassava and cassava flour may be available. Cassava flour and tapioca starch should not be treated as interchangeable with fresh cassava.
spec_easy_contexts: Ghana, Nigeria, Cameroon, Uganda, Brazil, parts of Indonesia
spec_harder_contexts: Germany, France, UK, US, Canada -- fresh roots uncommon

name: Plantain
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Ripe plantain, frozen plantain slices, or green bananas may work for cooked dishes, but ripeness and texture can change the result.
spec_easy_contexts: Ghana, Nigeria, Jamaica, West African, Central American, Caribbean
spec_harder_contexts: specialty or international grocery channels only

name: Tamarind
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Tamarind paste or concentrate can replace pods in many recipes. It is not suitable when the whole pod is required for presentation.
spec_harder_contexts: US, Canada, Germany, France, UK -- whole pods uncommon

name: Saffron
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Saffron threads or saffron extract may be suitable. Safflower can reproduce the color but not the aroma and should not be listed as an equivalent substitute.

name: Preserved lemon
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Salted lemon or lemon zest combined with salt can work in dressings and tagines, but it does not reproduce preserved-lemon texture.
spec_harder_contexts: US, Canada, Germany, France, UK -- specialty stores

name: Curry leaves
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Frozen or brined curry leaves may be available. There is no single herb with an equivalent flavor.
spec_harder_contexts: Germany, France, UK, US, Canada, Australia -- Asian or specialty stores

name: Makrut lime leaves
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Makrut leaves, frozen leaves, or makrut-lime zest may be suitable. Ordinary lime zest is a weaker approximation.
spec_harder_contexts: Europe, North America, Australia outside specialty stores

name: Gochujang
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Gochugaru combined with fermented soybean or chili paste can approximate some recipes, but the flavor and sweetness will differ.
spec_harder_contexts: Germany, France, UK, US, Canada, Australia -- Asian or specialty store

name: Doubanjiang
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: A generic chili bean paste may be suitable only when the recipe does not depend on a specific regional variety.

name: Fish sauce
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: A lighter fish sauce may be interchangeable in some dishes. Soy sauce should not be presented as an equivalent substitute because it changes the flavor profile.
spec_harder_contexts: US, Canada, Europe, Australia outside international grocery aisles

name: Fresh mozzarella di bufala
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Fresh cow’s-milk mozzarella can replace it in many dishes. Low-moisture mozzarella or provolone is suitable only when melted rather than served fresh.

name: Parmigiano Reggiano
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Grana Padano, another aged hard cheese, or Pecorino may be suitable depending on saltiness and the recipe.

name: Pecorino
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Grana Padano, another aged hard cheese, or Pecorino may be suitable depending on saltiness and the recipe.

name: Ube
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Ube puree or extract may be imported. Purple sweet potato can reproduce color but not the distinctive flavor and should be marked as an approximation.
spec_harder_contexts: US, Canada, Europe, Australia outside specialty stores

name: Ackee
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: There is no generally suitable substitute for ackee in dishes where its flavor and texture define the dish.
spec_harder_contexts: US -- commercial imports restricted; countries without an established supply

name: Huitlacoche
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Canned or imported huitlacoche is the closest alternative. Corn and mushroom do not provide a suitable substitute.

name: Asian pear
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Bosc pears or locally available nashi may be suitable for cooking, but sweetness and texture will differ.
spec_harder_contexts: US, Canada, Europe, Australia outside Asian specialty stores

name: Pandan
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Pandan extract or an approved pandan flavoring may work in many desserts, but it does not reproduce the aroma of fresh leaves.
spec_harder_contexts: Europe, North America, Australia outside specialty stores

name: Epazote
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Dried epazote may be suitable where the dish does not depend on fresh-leaf aroma. Parsley and cilantro are not equivalent substitutes.

name: Fresh corn masa
substitution_limits_from_the_spec: Masa harina, fresh masa prepared from masa harina, or corn tortillas may be suitable depending on whether the recipe requires tortillas, masa, or a specific texture.
spec_harder_contexts: only masa harina or packaged tortillas
